title: Reading List Canvas Rules
description: Rules local to the example package. Move them to ../_shared/rules.json when several Canvases need the same rules.

rules.title: Separate Canvas and Frame input ownership
rules.statement: In board and comment mode the Canvas owns pan/zoom; in frame run mode the HTML Frame owns its internal interaction.
rules.rationale: Prevents input conflicts between Canvas navigation and running a screen.

checks: In comment mode, a wheel event over a Frame pans the Canvas.
In frame run mode, scroll, hover and click work inside the Frame.

rules.title: Show state changes as a separate outcome Frame
rules.statement: When a user Action changes screen state, build the result as a separate Frame and join them with a Connection.
rules.rationale: Keeps cause and effect traceable even in a static design review.

checks: Every state-changing Action has an outcome Frame.
A Connection is defined between the Action and its outcome Frame.
